fullText.simplified:
第31章、你真的很聪明

    高静不说话了，她哭着放开了李河。李河又等了很久，高静还是不说话。
    李河只好继续说：“你先生是从窗户上掉下去的，但不是自己不小心掉下去的，是有人把他推下去的。是你推的，对吗？你和他在床上玩着打人的游戏，你们都没有穿衣服。你请他爬到窗户边，他以为这也是游戏，就爬了过去。然后你也走到窗户边，在他还在笑的时候，你突然把他推下去了。他掉下去的时候一定是既吃惊又难过，他那么爱你，那么相信你，从来没有怀疑过你，怎么想得到你要杀他？”
    “你让我相信你先生是被张一南杀死的，但如果我真的找到了张一南，那你怎么办呢？所以，你的计划又让我遇到了出租车司机，你知道我会看到那支笔，你也知道我会发现笔帽和笔都是你先生的，你还知道我会去检查你先生的抽屉，所以你提前在抽屉里面放了书、日记和照片。是的，我真笨，一点儿也没有怀疑，你又成功了。和你的计划一样，我都相信了，我以为所有的事情都是你先生一个人做的，以为是他自己从窗户边掉下去的，以为是他杀了他自己。”
    李河越说越难过，“你真的很聪明，我从来没有遇到过这么聪明的人。你的计划只有一个缺点，你只知道你先生把笔送给了出租车司机，但不知道他是什么时候送的。你应该问一问那个司机的，他那么热情，一定会告诉你的。当然，如果你知道笔是去年送的，就不会把笔帽放在天花板上了，那样，就不会有人发现是你杀了你先生，对吗？”
    高静没有哭了，不知道她在想什么，她一直不说话。
fullText.traditional:
第31章、你真的很聰明

    高靜不說話了，她哭著放開了李河。李河又等了很久，高靜還是不說話。
    李河只好繼續說：“你先生是從窗戶上掉下去的，但不是自己不小心掉下去的，是有人把他推下去的。是你推的，對嗎？你和他在床上玩著打人的遊戲，你們都沒有穿衣服。你請他爬到窗戶邊，他以為這也是遊戲，就爬了過去。然後你也走到窗戶邊，在他還在笑的時候，你突然把他推下去了。他掉下去的時候一定是既吃驚又難過，他那麼愛你，那麼相信你，從來沒有懷疑過你，怎麼想得到你要殺他？”
    “你讓我相信你先生是被張一南殺死的，但如果我真的找到了張一南，那你怎麼辦呢？所以，你的計劃又讓我遇到了出租車司機，你知道我會看到那支筆，你也知道我會發現筆帽和筆都是你先生的，你還知道我會去檢查你先生的抽屜，所以你提前在抽屜裡面放了書、日記和照片。是的，我真笨，一點兒也沒有懷疑，你又成功了。和你的計劃一樣，我都相信了，我以為所有的事情都是你先生一個人做的，以為是他自己從窗戶邊掉下去的，以為是他殺了他自己。”
    李河越說越難過，“你真的很聰明，我從來沒有遇到過這麼聰明的人。你的計劃只有一個缺點，你只知道你先生把筆送給了出租車司機，但不知道他是什麼時候送的。你應該問一問那個司機的，他那麼熱情，一定會告訴你的。當然，如果你知道筆是去年送的，就不會把筆帽放在天花板上了，那樣，就不會有人發現是你殺了你先生，對嗎？”
    高靜沒有哭了，不知道她在想什麼，她一直不說話。

sentences.traditional: 你請他爬到窗戶邊，他以為這也是遊戲，就爬了過去。

sentences.english: You asked him to climb onto the window. He thought this was also a game, so he climbed over.

sentences.traditional: 然後你也走到窗戶邊，在他還在笑的時候，你突然把他推下去了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu nǐ yě zǒu dào chuāng hu biān zài tā hái zài xiào de shí hou nǐ tū rán bǎ tā tuī xià qù le
sentences.english: Then you also went over to the window, and while he was still laughing, you suddenly pushed him down.

sentences.simplified: 他掉下去的时候一定是既吃惊又难过，
sentences.traditional: 他掉下去的時候一定是既吃驚又難過，
sentences.pinyin: tā diào xià qù de shí hou yí dìng shì jì chī jīng yòu nán guò
sentences.english: When he was falling down, he must have been both shocked and sad.

sentences.simplified: 他那么爱你，那么相信你，从来没有怀疑过你，怎么想得到你要杀他？”
sentences.traditional: 他那麼愛你，那麼相信你，從來沒有懷疑過你，怎麼想得到你要殺他？”
sentences.pinyin: tā nà me ài nǐ nà me xiāng xìn nǐ cóng lái méi yǒu huái yí guò nǐ zěn me xiǎng de dào nǐ yào shā tā
sentences.english: He loved you so much, trusted you so much, and never doubted you. How could he have figured out you wanted to kill him?”

sentences.simplified: “你让我相信你先生是被张一南杀死的，但如果我真的找到了张一南，那你怎么办呢？
sentences.traditional: “你讓我相信你先生是被張一南殺死的，但如果我真的找到了張一南，那你怎麼辦呢？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ ràng wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ xiān sheng shì bèi zhāng yī nán shā sǐ de dàn rú guǒ wǒ zhēn de zhǎo dào le zhāng yī nán nà nǐ zěn me bàn ne
sentences.english: “You made me believe your husband was killed by Zhang Yinan. But if I actually found Zhang Yinan, then what would you do?

sentences.simplified: 所以，你的计划又让我遇到了出租车司机，
sentences.traditional: 所以，你的計劃又讓我遇到了出租車司機，
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ nǐ de jì huà yòu ràng wǒ yù dào le chū zū chē sī jī
sentences.english: So, in your plan, you also made me encounter the taxi driver.

sentences.simplified: 你知道我会看到那支笔，你也知道我会发现笔帽和笔都是你先生的，
sentences.traditional: 你知道我會看到那支筆，你也知道我會發現筆帽和筆都是你先生的，
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào wǒ huì kàn dào nà zhī bǐ nǐ yě zhī dào wǒ huì fā xiàn bǐ mào hé bǐ dōu shì nǐ xiān sheng de
sentences.english: You knew that I would see that pen, and you also knew I would discover that the pen cap and the pen were your husband’s.

sentences.simplified: 你还知道我会去检查你先生的抽屉，所以你提前在抽屉里面放了书、日记和照片。
sentences.traditional: 你還知道我會去檢查你先生的抽屜，所以你提前在抽屜裡面放了書、日記和照片。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ hái zhī dào wǒ huì qù jiǎn chá nǐ xiān sheng de chōu ti suǒ yǐ nǐ tí qián zài chōu ti lǐ miàn fàng le shū rì jì hé zhào piàn
sentences.english: You also knew I would check your husband’s drawer, so you placed the book, diary, and photo in the drawer ahead of time.

sentences.simplified: 是的，我真笨，一点儿也没有怀疑，你又成功了。
sentences.traditional: 是的，我真笨，一點兒也沒有懷疑，你又成功了。
sentences.pinyin: shì de wǒ zhēn bèn yì diǎn'r yě méi yǒu huái yí nǐ yòu chéng gōng le
sentences.english: Yes, I was truly stupid. I didn’t suspect it at all. You succeeded again.

sentences.simplified: 和你的计划一样，我都相信了，我以为所有的事情都是你先生一个人做的，
sentences.traditional: 和你的計劃一樣，我都相信了，我以為所有的事情都是你先生一個人做的，
sentences.pinyin: hé nǐ de jì huà yí yàng wǒ dōu xiāng xìn le wǒ yǐ wéi suǒ yǒu de shì qing dōu shì nǐ xiān sheng yí ge rén zuò de
sentences.english: Just as you planned, I believed it all. I thought everything was done by your husband himself.

sentences.simplified: 以为是他自己从窗户边掉下去的，以为是他杀了他自己。”
sentences.traditional: 以為是他自己從窗戶邊掉下去的，以為是他殺了他自己。”
sentences.pinyin: yǐ wéi shì tā zì jǐ cóng chuāng hu biān diào xià qù de yǐ wéi shì tā shā le tā zì jǐ
sentences.english: I thought that he fell out of the window himself. I thought that he killed himself.”

sentences.simplified: 李河越说越难过，“你真的很聪明，我从来没有遇到过这么聪明的人。
sentences.traditional: 李河越說越難過，“你真的很聰明，我從來沒有遇到過這麼聰明的人。

sentences.english: Li He became more and more sad as he spoke: “You really are smart. I have never met anyone this smart.

sentences.simplified: 你的计划只有一个缺点，你只知道你先生把笔送给了出租车司机，但不知道他是什么时候送的。
sentences.traditional: 你的計劃只有一個缺點，你只知道你先生把筆送給了出租車司機，但不知道他是什麼時候送的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ de jì huà zhǐ yǒu yí ge quē diǎn nǐ zhǐ zhī dào nǐ xiān sheng bǎ bǐ sòng gěi le chū zū chē sī jī dàn bù zhī dào tā shì shén me shí hou sòng de
sentences.english: Your plan only had one flaw. You knew that your husband gave the pen to the taxi driver, but you didn’t know when he gave it to him.

sentences.simplified: 你应该问一问那个司机的，他那么热情，一定会告诉你的。
sentences.traditional: 你應該問一問那個司機的，他那麼熱情，一定會告訴你的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi wèn yí wèn nà ge sī jī de tā nà me rè qíng yí dìng huì gào su nǐ de
sentences.english: You should’ve asked that driver. He’s so friendly; he definitely would have told you.

sentences.simplified: 当然，如果你知道笔是去年送的，就不会把笔帽放在天花板上了，
sentences.traditional: 當然，如果你知道筆是去年送的，就不會把筆帽放在天花板上了，
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán rú guǒ nǐ zhī dào bǐ shì qù nián sòng de jiù bú huì bǎ bǐ mào fàng zài tiān huā bǎn shang le
sentences.english: Of course, if you had known that the pen was given to him last year, you wouldn’t have placed the pen cap in the ceiling.

sentences.simplified: 那样，就不会有人发现是你杀了你先生，对吗？”
sentences.traditional: 那樣，就不會有人發現是你殺了你先生，對嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nà yàng jiù bú huì yǒu rén fā xiàn shì nǐ shā le nǐ xiān sheng duì ma
sentences.english: That way, nobody would’ve discovered that it was you who killed your husband, right?”

sentences.simplified: 高静没有哭了，不知道她在想什么，她一直不说话。
sentences.traditional: 高靜沒有哭了，不知道她在想什麼，她一直不說話。
sentences.pinyin: gāo jìng méi yǒu kū le bù zhī dào tā zài xiǎng shén me tā yì zhí bù shuō huà
sentences.english: Gao Jing didn’t cry anymore. Who knew what she was thinking? She didn’t speak at all.

sentence_translations: Chapter 31: You Really Are Smart
Gao Jing no longer spoke. She cried as she let go of Li He.
Li He waited for a very long time, but Gao Jing still didn’t say anything.
Li He could only carry on speaking:
“Your husband fell down from the window, but he didn’t fall down by accident. Someone pushed him down.
It was you who pushed him, right? You and he were in bed playing the hitting game. Neither of you were wearing any clothes.
You asked him to climb onto the window. He thought this was also a game, so he climbed over.
Then you also went over to the window, and while he was still laughing, you suddenly pushed him down.
When he was falling down, he must have been both shocked and sad.
He loved you so much, trusted you so much, and never doubted you. How could he have figured out you wanted to kill him?”
“You made me believe your husband was killed by Zhang Yinan. But if I actually found Zhang Yinan, then what would you do?
So, in your plan, you also made me encounter the taxi driver.
You knew that I would see that pen, and you also knew I would discover that the pen cap and the pen were your husband’s.
You also knew I would check your husband’s drawer, so you placed the book, diary, and photo in the drawer ahead of time.
Yes, I was truly stupid. I didn’t suspect it at all. You succeeded again.
Just as you planned, I believed it all. I thought everything was done by your husband himself.
I thought that he fell out of the window himself. I thought that he killed himself.”
Li He became more and more sad as he spoke: “You really are smart. I have never met anyone this smart.
Your plan only had one flaw. You knew that your husband gave the pen to the taxi driver, but you didn’t know when he gave it to him.
You should’ve asked that driver. He’s so friendly; he definitely would have told you.
Of course, if you had known that the pen was given to him last year, you wouldn’t have placed the pen cap in the ceiling.
That way, nobody would’ve discovered that it was you who killed your husband, right?”
Gao Jing didn’t cry anymore. Who knew what she was thinking? She didn’t speak at all.
